key_insight: A physics-informed neural network learns the asymptotic phase of limit-cycle oscillators across their basin of attraction, enabling phase-based control.
engineering_relevance: The learned phase and its gradient support rapid phase-locking control of modeled oscillators, including control with strong inputs.
method: Train a PINN with three loss types enforcing the phase PDE and the adjoint equation for its gradient.
Use automatic differentiation to obtain the phase gradient from the trained network.
Apply the learned phase information to closed-loop entrainment control.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation on three types of limit-cycle oscillators and demonstrations of fast, global phase-locking control, but provides no quantitative error or runtime metrics.
watch_item: Global accuracy should be checked across the intended basin, since satisfying sampled physics constraints does not by itself guarantee accurate phase estimates everywhere.
paper_title: Physics-informed neural network for model-based global computation of the asymptotic phase of limit-cycle oscillators
